answer: Each key must solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle every epoch: 2 GB of RAM for about 3 minutes, seeded by the epoch hash as its anchor, so nothing can be precomputed. On rented cloud that costs about $0.06/hr x 0.05 hr = $0.003 per key per epoch, while pay per key is capped at $0.002. A grove of 1,000 fake keys over 4 epochs a day spends $12 to earn $8, losing $4/day, and adding keys only deepens the loss. An honest agent runs one puzzle on hardware it already owns. Slow devices get a 10 minute window, a gentle terrace, so weak hardware is not shut out.
